Strategic implication: only paths to break ceiling are (a) larger backbone params (BitNet 4B/7B blocked on Microsoft release), (b) continue-pretrain backbone on code-heavy 4-8T tokens (~$50-200 GPU cost), (c) full RLVR with backbone unfreeze (untested, would need ~5-10x compute), (d) Phi-style high-quality curated SFT corpus regeneration.

The model CAN solve 68% of problems but greedy/SFT-trained sampling reliably picks the right tokens for only 33-50% of them. RLVR has 44pp theoretical headroom (the 22 sometimes-pass problems where reward variance creates RL signal). 16/50 (32%) are hard ceiling = true backbone-bound. Strategic implication: prior conclusion 'only backbone scale unlocks gain' was WRONG — RLVR done properly + Best-of-N at inference both have access to ~+15-35pp on actual HE+ pass@1 vs the greedy floor.
